_note: Ad copy lives here so it can be edited without touching the renderer. Every line is checked against Meta's health/wellness rule: NAME THE SERVICE, never address the reader's or the child's condition. 'Depression counselling' is allowed; 'Depression getting you down?' is not. Egyptian colloquial, because English-only dramatically underperforms in Egypt.
